notes: Reference: 70 companies with reference answers (2 duplicate rows merged), bands inferred by an analyst from public pages, not your team's ratings.
Matched 69 of 70 reference companies to an assessment; the rest were not scored.

Age baseline: the band from company age alone (under 5 years 1-3, 5 to 9.5 years 4-6, older 7-9; for investment readiness pre-seed, seed, Series A or later), from the register date in the key. It is scored on the same companies as ours; where the age is unknown it abstains and counts as a miss.
Investment readiness: our 1-9 scale maps to stages (1-6 pre-seed, 7-8 seed, 9 Series A or later); late-stage and public companies in the keys fall in the top stage.
Ocean impact: our own 1-5 scale, uncalibrated. No reference keys exist, so n = 0.
